description: This file contains functions for parsing and identifying user agent strings, including platform, OS, browser, and application version detection, specific to Mattermost client and server interactions.

methods.name: getPlatformName
methods.description: Determines the platform name based on user agent OS and string content.

methods.name: getOSName
methods.description: Returns the OS name, with special handling for Windows versions and fallback for unknown OS.

methods.name: GetDesktopAppVersion
methods.description: Extracts the desktop application version from the user agent string if present.

methods.name: getBrowserVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the browser version from user agent string, prioritizing specific prefixes.

methods.name: limitStringLength
methods.description: Limits a string to a maximum length to prevent potential issues.

methods.name: getUAVersion
methods.description: Formats the user agent version string based on major, minor, and patch numbers.

methods.name: getBrowserName
methods.description: Identifies the browser name, including special cases for Electron, Mattermost, and mmctl.
